fit_theta_model: fit a ThetaModel on univariate time series data with seasonal and drift components
predict_theta_forecast: predict future values with a fitted ThetaModel returning forecast and confidence intervals
check_seasonality_theta: check if a time series has seasonal patterns using autocorrelation in ThetaModel
deseasonalize_theta_data: deseasonalize input time series data using multiplicative decomposition in ThetaModel
get_theta_param_space: get the default parameter search space for tuning a ThetaModel
